descriptor: Quick notes app with fast actions

voice.summary: Sounds like a pen that is always at hand: very short phrases, active verbs, no ceremony. Actions are labelled like a note's first word.
dos: Start every action with a verb
Show state in the label, not a paragraph

taglines: Notes at the speed of thought
boilerplate: Jotter is a notes app built for speed, with a floating action button that fans out into new note, checklist, voice and photo in a single motion.

microcopy.error: Could not save that note, try again
microcopy.empty: No notes yet, tap the plus to start

logo.note: A spark suggests an idea captured in an instant.
